current_task_corrections.correction: Remove member_sex, member_race_ethnicity, member_age_band, and fraud_pattern_type from feature_comparison's features list. Use only claim-level features (claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, billed_amount, allowed_amount, paid_amount, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, auth_required_flag, high_cost_flag) and member_payer_type.
Add 'no_operational_use' to the caveats array in write_report component parameters.

reusable_lessons.lesson: Exclude label-derived fields (e.g., fraud_pattern_type, which is populated only when fraud_label=1) and protected attributes (member_sex, member_race_ethnicity, member_age_band) from feature comparisons to prevent data leakage and protect against bias in statistical analysis.
Always include the 'no_operational_use' caveat when writing exploratory analysis reports to explicitly state that findings are descriptive and must not be used for operational decisions.
